focus: Static review of translated/extreme/empty rig overhead fit and complete rectangular modifier bounds; SceneKit projection excluded.

checks.observation: Scene validation precedes bounds construction. Subject, camera, light centers and aimed targets participate. All four rectangular emitting-face corners use the actual right/up frame; derived corners are deliberately not clamped to Position.coordinateRange.

Authored coordinates are finite within -100...100; rectangular dimensions are finite within 0.05...4. EmitterFrame receives effectiveRollDegrees and UnitDirection normalizes through maximum-component scaling. These bounds keep corner, center, extent and radius arithmetic finite for validated scenes. A coincident source/target produces an unavailable modifier ID while retaining its center.

Center and half extents are computed from min/max. overheadFit uses dimensions rather than origin distance, validates viewport/padding/minimum span, chooses the smaller axis scale and projects relative to bounds center. Empty coincident scenes retain zero radius and obtain a centered positive-scale minimum span.

Six explicit test cases cover rigid translation including manual aim targets, all face corners and padding for a large vertical-aim modifier, visibility-dependent aim-target inclusion, undefined modifier orientation, empty coincident scene and valid boundary centers with derived corners beyond the authoring limit. Assertions check scale/layout/center/radius invariance, extrema, finite projection and padding.

Four additional cases cover invalid scene/viewport/minimum-span rejection, near-padding-threshold and narrow viewport grids, translated grid alignment and line-limit/unrepresentable-span handling. Grid code bounds loops and allocation, limits requests to 512 lines per axis and avoids conversion of unbounded coordinates to Int.
This source-only review does not establish Debug/Release execution, required native/UI acceptance, actual screenshots, physical validation or milestone completion.

limitations: Host unavailable: no shell commands, agent_cycle scripts, Swift tests, builds, simulator runs or runtime measurements were executed.

Repository startup and acceptance documents were read; reported historical execution outcomes were not revalidated by this worker.
conclusion: No actionable defect established in the assigned source/test scope. Existing tests meaningfully target translated, extreme and empty fits plus modifier corners; runtime results remain unverified.
